value.device: Apple Silicon CPU; no model loading, queue waiting or network calls; OS cache uncontrolled; sequential invocation.
value.warning: Exploratory variants and control pages are heterogeneous, so the aggregate is diagnostic rather than a before/after production latency comparison.

Stage latency.method: perf_counter around native page parsing and table variants; includes artifact serialization where timed
Stage latency.aggregation: mean, P50, P95 with linear interpolation; heterogeneous workloads reported separately

Token usage and cost.reason: Native parser exploration only; no retrieval, generated answers, provider calls, ingestion, index or load workload.

Reliability.method: Retained parser variant completion records; success is not extraction correctness

Concurrency and throughput.reason: Heterogeneous sequential parser probes, not production load capacity.
Concurrency and throughput.method: Total completed variants divided by retained probe wall time

Ingestion and index.reason: Native parser exploration only; no retrieval, generated answers, provider calls, ingestion, index or load workload.

baseline.label: Collapsed original table has no row/column hierarchy matching these annotations; numeric presence alone is not cell association.

additional_parser_quality_metrics.population: Three previously observed development rows, 75 explicitly annotated cells
additional_parser_quality_metrics.method: Derive leaf header row from all occupied physical columns and parent spans by containing each leaf cell center. Compare exact full header paths and row-labeled cells. Preserve blanks as explicit cell geometry. Full-width title/date are table context, not parent labels for every field.
additional_parser_quality_metrics.aggregation: Separate counts for numeric values, blanks, labels, header paths, merged groups and exact rows

canonical_span_integration.reason: Probe outputs native geometry and text only. Production PdfExtraction offsets and downstream indexing are not implemented here.

failed_verification_attempts.reason: The report link checker incorrectly required its own not-yet-written measurement.json target. Retained failure; checker now treats that output as the current creation target.

report_review.method: Original-page visual inspection plus raw candidate/gold comparison; local link and formatting inspection
